overview: Tech stands among the saga's most memorable figures, known throughout the galaxy as a clone commando. The Bad Batch's genius technician who could slice systems, decode languages, and engineer solutions under fire. From backwater cantinas to senate chambers and fleet command centers, Tech's story illustrates how individuals outside the Jedi and Sith orders can still move history.
